messages:
sophia: Quick flag — saw a cluster of metering anomalies tied to route pin TTL after last canary. Tenants showing token attribution moving between v1/v2 mid-request :eyes:

miguel: Yep, same. Dashboard spike around the pin-window boundary. Wondering if the default TTL change got deployed without the quota-layer mapping.

ava: The PR changed the default for pin TTL as part of the handoff experiment (7d -> 1h) to avoid long-lived affinity during early v2 rollout. That was intentional but I forgot to wire the quota reconciliation hooks. My bad. :grimacing:

devex-charles: Oof — user-facing symptom is "silent switch" for SDKs that rely on implicit pinning. We should add an explicit opt-in header so SDKs can be deterministic instead of depending on server TTL. Suggested header: `X-Redwood-Route-Pin: <seconds|off>`

sophia: Agreed on the header. Also need console surface changes: show per-route pin TTL, and a small viz for "pin churn" (how many requests re-routed across versions inside a single session). Right now the metering graph looks like token counts move around but we can't tie it to pin boundaries.

miguel: For telemetry we can emit a compact event at pin boundary: `pin.boundary { tenant, route_id, old_pin, new_pin, reason }`. That won't be high-cardinality but will let us correlate quota attribution deltas.

ava: Another wrinkle: autoswitch policy will attempt route-affinity fallbacks which create short-lived duplicates for a tiny percent of requests. If quota accounting attributes to both variants during that window we overcount. We should decide one of: 1) attribute to origin variant for N seconds post-switch, or 2) attribute final variant and backfill original.

devex-charles: Option 1 seems simpler for billing clarity. We should expose the backfill behavior in console copy so customers know why an invoice might show a small discrepancy.

ops-bot: alert: RouteQuotaSpike detected for tenant alpha-inc (route /generate-chat) — spike delta +12% in 10m :chart_with_upwards_trend:

sophia: ops-bot thanks — can we add a small console alert mapping from these spikes to the pin-ttl flag? e.g., link the spike tile to the route config page and surface current TTL + last change commit SHA.

miguel: Implementation plan: 1) Add `X-Redwood-Route-Pin` header + SDK opt-in guidance. 2) Emit `pin.boundary` telemetry event. 3) Console: show TTL, last-changed, and pin-churn metric. 4) Quota: implement attribution rule defaulting to origin variant for 60s post-switch (configurable per-tenant).

ava: I'll open a PR for header + telemetry and a follow-up for quota-attribution. Can we get a quick UX mock for the console tile? I can wire backend events to it.

devex-charles: I'll draft SDK docs and a migration note. Also recommend a short-term console banner saying: "routing pin TTL reduced; enable explicit pin header to avoid silent switch" with a one-click link to toggle per-route override.

sophia: Thanks — timeline? This feels P1 for anyone on Dedicated or Private where billing clarity matters.

ava: PR for header + telemetry by EOD. Quota change as a feature flag next week — will need oncall review.

miguel: I'll add alert-rule to map RouteQuotaSpike -> route config URL. Also add a small metric `pin.churn_rate` to reduce detective work.

devex-charles: Will draft console copy + billing explainer and ping legal for wording.

sophia: Great. One more ask: add a debug endpoint for ops to query current pin state for a token so SRE can inspect live cases. Something like `/internal/debug/pin_state?token=...`. Keep it gated behind admin auth.

ava: ack — will include debug endpoint in PR.

sophia: Perfect. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
